name: High Puna salt plateau
surface: Red-brown and grey bare rock and gravel high plateau with white salt flats (Salar de Tara, Salar de Pujsa, Salar de Quisquiro) and small lakes (Laguna Blanca, Laguna de Vilama).
special: Volcanoes all around (Cerro Zapaleri, Nevado de San Pedro, Cerro Purípica). Very dry, no green plants. Only the small town of Susques nearby.
testHere: Rover mobility on gravel and volcanic rock
Life-detection instruments in salt flats
Solar power under very strong UV
notValid: Lagoons hold living microbes and birds
Air pressure is far higher than on Mars

name: Salar de Arizaro
surface: Red-brown and grey bare rock and gravel high plateau with a huge white salt flat in the middle and smaller salt patches to the west, one with a small turquoise lake.
special: Volcanoes and mountains all around (Volcán Llullaillaco, Cerro Archibarca, Cerro Tebenquicho). Very dry, no green plants, no towns nearby.
testHere: Landing and navigation on wide, flat salt surfaces
Drilling into salt deposits
Long-distance rover traverses far from people
notValid: Salt crust is wetter than Martian soil
Air pressure is far higher than on Mars

name: Xungba plateau
surface: Light brown and grey rocky mountains with folded ridges, small turquoise and green lakes, white dry salt lakes and one big dark blue lake.
special: High, dry plateau with almost no plants. A small settlement, Xungba, in the middle.
testHere: Navigation across ridges and valleys
Studying dry salt lakes as ancient-lake analogs
Cold-night battery and thermal tests
notValid: Big lakes still hold liquid water

name: Sangsang highlands
surface: Brown and dark grey rocky mountains with many ridges and valleys, snow on some peaks, a small dark green lake and a pale dry lake.
special: Very dry with almost no plants. Two small towns, Sangsang and Quxar.
testHere: Rover mobility on steep, rocky terrain
Team operations with nearby logistics
Cold-season equipment tests

name: Xijir Ulan Hu basin
surface: Red-brown and grey hills with large pale grey-blue lakes (Xijir Ulan Hu, probably salty or frozen), snow on a few peaks and pale dry riverbeds.
special: Very dry, no plants, no towns or roads nearby. One of the most remote places in Asia.
testHere: Ice and frozen-lake drilling
Remote operations with no outside help
Studying dry riverbeds like Martian channels
notValid: Air pressure is far higher than on Mars

name: Qaidam Basin floor near Mahai
surface: Flat light brown and beige desert plain of sand and gravel, brown-grey mountains, small green-blue salt ponds and a dark green lake.
special: Very dry. A few small towns (like Mahai) and roads, so it is easy to reach.
testHere: Salt and sediment studies like the lake beds of Jezero and Gale
Easy-access rover tests close to roads
Wind and dust erosion studies
notValid: Lower altitude, so warmer and thicker air than the other sites
Salt ponds are man-made in places

name: Lake Sarez
surface: Dark brown and grey high mountains with snow and ice on the peaks, a long narrow turquoise lake (Lake Sarez) and a small blue-green lake.
special: Lake Sarez formed when a huge landslide blocked a river in 1911. No towns or roads.
testHere: Studying landslide-dammed lakes and slope collapse
Mobility on steep, unstable slopes
Operations in very remote terrain
notValid: A deep lake of liquid water
